'''Dak Williks''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Citizens' Militia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he tasked a Republic spacer to help him slow the attacks on the local settlements by entering the camps of the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] and cutting down their numbers.<ref name="TOR" />
